AXBrailleMap.doc: A representation of a two-dimensional braille display.

AXBrailleTable.doc: A rule for translating print text to Braille, and back-translating Braille to print text.

AXBrailleTranslationResult.doc: The result of translation or back-translation.

AXBrailleTranslator.doc: Translates print text to Braille and Braille to print text according to the given Braille table.

AXCategoricalDataAxisDescriptor.doc: An object that represents an axis of categorical data.

AXChartDescriptor.doc: An object that contains all the semantic information about an accessible chart.

AXCustomContent.doc: Objects that define custom content and the timing of its output.

AXDataPoint.doc: An object that represents a single data point in a chart.

AXDataSeriesDescriptor.doc: An object that represents a series of data points.

AXLiveAudioGraph.doc: An object that represents an audio graph for a live-updating, continuous data series for VoiceOver.

AXNumericDataAxisDescriptor.doc: An object that represents an axis of numerical data.

AXBrailleMapRenderer.doc: The interface for providing data for a braille map.

AXChart.doc: A protocol that declares the minimum interface necessary for an accessibility element to act as a chart.

AXCustomContentProvider.doc: The interface for customizing the accessibility content.

AXDataAxisDescriptor.doc: The basic interface for a data axis in a chart.

AXChartDescriptorContentDirection.doc: A constant that describes the content direction of the chart.

AXCustomContentImportance.doc: Objects that control the timing of content output.

AXHearingDeviceEar.doc: Constants that represent a hearing device ear.

AXHearingDeviceEarNone.doc: A constant that represents neither ear.

AXNumericDataAxisDescriptorScale.doc: Constants that describe the scale of a numeric axis.

-heightAtPoint:.doc: Retrieves the height of an individual pin on the braille display.

-presentImage:.doc: Converts the data from the image you specify into the braille map.

-setHeight:atPoint:.doc: Sets the height of an individual pin on the braille display.

+defaultTableForLocale:.doc: The default table that provides translations for the given locale’s language. Returns nil if there is none.

+languageAgnosticTables.doc: All tables that are not specific to any language.

+supportedLocales.doc: All locales supported by existing tables.

+tablesForLocale:.doc: All tables that provide translations for the given locale’s language.

-initWithIdentifier:.doc: Returns nil if there is no table with the given identifier.

-backTranslateBraille:.doc: Input Braille should use the unicode Braille characters (0x2800-0x28FF).

-translatePrintText:.doc: Output Braille uses the unicode Braille characters (0x2800-0x28FF).

-initWithAttributedTitle:categoryOrder:.doc: Creates a categorical data axis with the specified attributed title and an array of categories in the specified order.

-initWithTitle:categoryOrder:.doc: Creates a categorical data axis with the specified title and an array of categories in the specified order.

Creates a chart descriptor with the specified attributed title, summary, x-axis descriptor, y-axis descriptor, and array of data series.

Creates a chart descriptor with the specified title, summary, x-axis descriptor, y-axis descriptor, descriptors for additional axes, and array of data series.

+customContentWithAttributedLabel:attrib.doc: Creates new custom content with an attributed string and attributed value.

+customContentWithLabel:value:.doc: Creates new custom content with a label and value.

-initWithX:y:.doc: Creates a data point with the specified x- and y-values.

-initWithX:y:additionalValues:.doc: Creates a data point with the specified x-value, y-value, and additional values.

-initWithX:y:additionalValues:label:.doc: Creates a data point with the specified x-value, y-value, additional values, and label.

+valueWithCategory:.doc: Creates a categorical data value with the specified category string.

+valueWithNumber:.doc: Creates a numeric data value with the specified number.

-initWithAttributedName:isContinuous:dat.doc: Creates a data series with the specified attributed name, a Boolean value that indicates whether the series is continuous, and data points.

-initWithName:isContinuous:dataPoints:.doc: Creates a data series with the specified name, a Boolean value that indicates whether the series is continuous, and data points.

+start.doc: Begins the live audio graph session.

+stop.doc: Ends the live audio graph session.

+updateValue:.doc: Sets the pitch of the audio graph’s tone.

-initWithTitle:lowerBound:upperBound:gri.doc: Creates a numeric data axis with the specified title, lower bound value, upper bound value, gridline positions, and value description provider block.

dimensions.doc: The number of pins in each dimension of the braille display.

subscript(_:).doc: Accesses the height of an individual pin on the braille display.

identifier.doc: A unique string that identifies this table.

isEightDot.doc: Returns true if this table makes use of eight dots as opposed to six dots.

language.doc: The 3-character code from ISO 639-2 for the language this Braille table pertains to.

localizedName.doc: The localized name of this table for user display.

localizedProviderName.doc: The localized name of the provider of this table for user display.

providerIdentifier.doc: The identifier of the provider of this table.

inputIndex(forResultIndex:).doc: Maps a location in the resultString to where it came from in the input string.

locationMap.doc: An array of integers that has the same length as the resultString. locationMap[i]-th character in the input string corresponds to resultString[i].

resultString.doc: The resulting string after translation or back-translation.

categoryOrder.doc: A list of every category value for the axis in the order they appear visually in the graph or legend.

AXChartDescriptorContentDirection.doc: A constant that describes the content direction of the chart.

additionalAxes.doc: The descriptors for additional categorical or numerical axes beyond the x-axis and y-axis.

attributedTitle.doc: An attributed version of the chart title.

contentDirection.doc: The direction of the content in the chart.

contentFrame.doc: The bounds of the view, in screen coordinates, for visually rendering data values.

init(title:summary:xAxis:yAxis:additiona.doc: Creates a chart descriptor with the specified title, summary, x-axis descriptor, y-axis descriptor, descriptors for additional axes, and array of data series.

series.doc: The descriptors for each data series in the chart.

summary.doc: A description of the key takeaways or features of the chart.

xAxis.doc: The axis descriptor for the chart’s x-axis.

yAxis.doc: The axis descriptor for the chart’s y-axis.

AXCustomContentImportance.doc: Objects that control the timing of content output.

attributedLabel.doc: A localized attributed string that identifies the label for this content.

attributedValue.doc: A localized attributed string that provides a value for the label.

importance.doc: An object that determines when to output custom accessibility content.

label.doc: A localized string that identifies the label for this content.

value.doc: A localized string that provides a value for the label.

AXDataPoint.Value.doc: Constants that describe types of data values.

additionalValues.doc: An array of values for additional axes for the data point.

attributedLabel.doc: An attributed version of the label for the data point.

label.doc: The label for the data point.

xValue.doc: The value of the x-axis for the data point.

yValue.doc: The value of the y-axis for the data point.

category.doc: A string that represents the categorical data value.

number.doc: A number that represents the numeric data value.

attributedName.doc: An attributed version of the data series name.

dataPoints.doc: The data points that the series contains.

isContinuous.doc: A Boolean value that determines whether the data series is continuous.

name.doc: The name of the data series.

AXNumericDataAxisDescriptorScale.doc: Constants that describe the scale of a numeric axis.

gridlinePositions.doc: The positions of the gridlines along the axis.

lowerBound.doc: The minimum displayable value for the axis.

range.doc: A range that defines the minimum and maximum displayable values for the axis.

upperBound.doc: The maximum displayable value for the axis.

valueDescriptionProvider.doc: A description to speak for a particular data value on the axis.
